summary_md: **Bora Baysal ([@BoraBaysal](https://x.com/BoraBaysal/status/2115237517058531402))** adds a scanner for fake AI-agent skills and apps to **Agent Supply-Chain Auditor**: it flags look-alike names (e.g. homoglyph package names), prompt injection, hidden text and key-stealing code in Hermes/OpenClaw skills.
